description_en: Queries the list of phases that belong to a collaboration model
description_zh: 查询协同模型所属的阶段列表
name: ListMPCoSPhase

parameters.help_en: The API version number. Set the value to "1.0.0"
parameters.name: api_version

parameters.help_en: The page number of the results to return. Minimum value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页，最小取值是1
parameters.name: num

parameters.help_en: The number of records to display on each page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，最大值是100
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the business chain
parameters.name: biz_chain_id

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the collaboration model
parameters.name: phase_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the phase to query.
If this parameter is not specified, all phases under the collaboration model are queried
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的阶段名称。
不传则查询该协同模型下所有阶段
parameters.name: name
